test_title: PYST 23: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements: All shirts are trousers. All trousers are pants. No pant is a coat.

Conclusion (I) : No shirt is a coat.

Conclusion (II) : No trouser is a coat.
solution:
Statements: All shirts are trousers. All trousers are pants. No pant is a coat.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f32a2e924b0c4a4b7907d5efd23c2baeadd5db630b50acdb46ff2356268ba2b3.png] 

Conclusion (I) : No shirt is a coat. - True (Because All shirts are trousers, All trousers are pants and No pant is a coat, which means all shirts being pants are not coat.)

Conclusion (II) : No trouser is a coat. - True (Because All trousers are pants and No pant is a coat, which means all trousers being pants are not coat.)

Thus, Both follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
